featured_reviews.name: Kamlesh Gadilohar
featured_reviews.review_text:
1/5 – One of the Worst Mughlai Dining Experiences We've Had

We visited Delhi Darbar, Jogeshwari West for my brother's birthday celebration, expecting the quality and hospitality associated with the Delhi Darbar name. Unfortunately, it turned out to be one of the most disappointing dining experiences we've had.

We started with roasted and fried papad. The roasted papad had a small hair on it. I quietly removed it without informing my family to avoid spoiling the occasion, but such hygiene lapses should never happen.

For starters, we ordered the Shahi Kebab Platter, Mutton Kebab, and Finger Chips. The kebabs were the only items that tasted genuinely good, although the quantity was quite small. Even the Finger Chips portion was surprisingly small considering the pricing.

The rest of the food was disappointing:

Veg Crispy was overloaded with oil and had the smell of reused cooking oil. We hardly ate any of it and packed almost the entire dish. Nobody from the staff bothered to ask whether there was an issue.
Chicken Schezwan Tandoori seemed to be prepared using stale tandoori chicken.
Butter Chicken was very average and lacked the richness expected from a reputed Mughlai restaurant.
Mutton Masala was swimming in oil and had an ordinary taste.
Paneer Tikka Biryani contained hard paneer pieces, excessive oil, and very little flavor.
The Chicken Dum Biryani was the biggest disappointment. The rice quality was shockingly poor, consisting largely of broken "tukda" rice that we wouldn't even use for khichdi at home. It was excessively oily and filled with potato pieces. For a restaurant known for Mughlai cuisine, serving a biryani of this quality is simply unacceptable.

The service was equally disappointing. At one point, one of our family members had to get a plate himself because the attending manager was busy on a phone call. The manager came across as rude, inattentive, and unprofessional. Basic hospitality and customer service seemed completely missing.

What made the experience even more frustrating was that despite several dishes being left unfinished, no one from the staff showed any concern or made an effort to understand whether there was a problem with the food.

Our bill exceeded ₹5,000, yet the overall quality of food and service was nowhere near the level expected for that price. My family and I have dined at numerous Mughlai restaurants across Mumbai over the years, ranging from small establishments to premium dining venues, and this was honestly one of the worst experiences we've had.

A birthday celebration that should have been memorable for the right reasons ended up being memorable for all the wrong ones.

Poor food quality, excessive use of oil, questionable freshness, hygiene concerns, small portions, indifferent service, and premium pricing that simply doesn't match the experience. Based on this visit, I would not recommend Delhi Darbar, Jogeshwari West.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are hunting for genuine, no-fuss Konkani and Malvani food in Mumbai, your search ends at Konkan Swad in Jogeshwari West. This restaurant is truly a hidden gem, offering an unparalleled taste of the coast that transports you straight to the shores of Ratnagiri and Sindhudurg. It's the kind of place you visit when you crave authentic, home-style seafood and fiery curries.
The highlight here is, without a doubt, the seafood. The fish is always incredibly fresh—a mandatory requirement for any great coastal establishment. I highly recommend starting with the Bombil Fry (Bombay Duck) or the Surmai Fry. The coating is perfectly crisp, and the marinade is a flawless blend of chili, turmeric, and spice. For the main course, the Prawn Curry Thali is a masterpiece; rich, coconut-based gravy that pairs perfectly with the soft, fluffy Vade (puri made from rice and lentil flour). If you prefer meat, the Chicken Malvani Thali is equally robust and satisfying.
Beyond the main courses, don't miss out on the incredible Solkadhi. This kokam-based digestive drink is creamy, tangy, and absolutely essential for cooling the palate after the spicy Konkani flavors. It’s one of the best I've had outside of a Konkani home.
The ambiance is simple, clean, and unpretentious, allowing the focus to remain solely on the food, as it should be. The staff is warm, helpful, and eager to offer recommendations, making the entire dining experience feel incredibly homely. If you love coastal flavors, fresh fish, and authentic Malvani spices, Konkan Swad is a must-visit destination in Jogeshwari. Highly, highly recommended!

I’ve visited Cafe Safar in Andheri three times, and here’s my experience.

The Chicken Chilli is perfect for those who enjoy Chinese-style dishes—spicy and flavorful.

The Chicken Crispy was also great—crispy, spicy, and full of taste.

Chicken Fried Rice and Chicken Lollipop with sauce weren’t very spicy but tasted good and came in good quantity.

The plain Chicken Lollipop was hot and crispy, though a bit chewy inside.

The Mix Platter comes with 10 pieces of 4 types of tikka and kebab. Since we didn’t want kebabs, we asked to change them. The staff said we could swap within the four tikkas included, without extra charge, or choose other tikkas from the menu with an extra cost. It’s nice that they allow some customization.

The Chicken Biryani and Cafe Safar Special Falooda were okay.

They don’t have many cold drink options, but besides their ice cream menu, they also have some extra ice creams stored in the fridge.

Overall: A good place for spicy starters and decent food. Worth visiting if you're nearby.

Sabri Sheesh Mahal is strategically located near Jogeshwari Station, making it easily accessible for guests traveling by public transport. The venue is right on SV Road, which is a prime location in the heart of Mumbai, and it’s easy to find. The proximity to the station is a huge advantage, especially for guests who prefer public transportation or those traveling from different parts of the city. There’s also ample parking space nearby, which made it easier for guests who drove to the venue.

Ambiance & Décor:
The moment I stepped into the venue, I was impressed by the grandiose ambiance. The hall has been beautifully designed with intricate decor, luxurious chandeliers, and ambient lighting that creates a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The combination of contemporary and traditional designs gives the venue a sophisticated yet festive feel, which is perfect for events like weddings, receptions, and corporate gatherings.

The aesthetic appeal of the space is enhanced by well-placed floral arrangements, elegant drapes, and rich furniture. It’s clear that a lot of thought has gone into the design and layout of the venue, making it ideal for any grand occasion. The open floor space allows for a large number of guests to comfortably enjoy the event without feeling cramped.

Service & Staff:
One of the standout features of Sabri Sheesh Mahal is its exceptional service. The staff was incredibly attentive and courteous throughout the event. From the moment I arrived, the event coordinators ensured that everything was in place. They made sure all guests were well taken care of, guiding us to our seats and helping with any requests. The staff was always available to assist with any queries, and their friendly demeanor made the experience even more enjoyable.

The venue also has a team of technicians available 24/7 to ensure that the audio-visual systems, lighting, and other technical aspects of the event run smoothly. This is particularly important for events like weddings, where the coordination of lighting, sound systems, and visual displays is key to setting the mood.

Food & Catering:
The catering services at Sabri Sheesh Mahal are worth mentioning. The food was absolutely delicious, and the variety on offer was impressive. From starters to main courses and desserts, every dish was served fresh and hot. The quality of the food was exceptional, and it catered to a variety of tastes. I particularly enjoyed the delicious Mughlai dishes and the tender kebabs. The vegetarian options were equally tasty, with flavorful dishes that everyone enjoyed.

The food presentation was also spot on, with beautifully garnished plates that added to the overall experience. The venue offers both buffet-style and plated service, depending on the type of event, and the staff ensures that the food service is prompt and efficient.

Facilities & Amenities:
Sabri Sheesh Mahal offers a range of facilities that make it an ideal venue for large-scale events. The banquet hall is spacious and well-maintained, with a capacity to host hundreds of guests comfortably. The hall is equipped with a high-quality sound system, projector screens, and ambient lighting, making it suitable for both formal and informal gatherings.

Additionally, the toilets and washrooms were clean and well-stocked, which is an important consideration for any event venue. The air conditioning was perfectly set, ensuring a comfortable environment throughout the event, especially given Mumbai's weather.

I ordered the Mutton Bori Style Biryani, Dal Bukhara, and three varieties of tikka. While the tikkas were good and tasted as expected, the biryani was extremely disappointing. We tried the Paneer Roast Masala Biryani, Lasooni Palak Paneer and Paneer Makhani Biryani Meal Box. Loved the packaging which was sealed with proper plastic wrapping ensuring tamper proof and spill proof. Food was superb in taste and quantities they serve is really recommendable!

I loved the lasooni palak paneer which was great in taste and was a perfect match for the dinner. Paneer Biryani comes with raita. Taste was superb and it was cooked well. It had an amazing aroma. Paneer Makhani Biryani Meal Box was a great pick which comes with galouti kebabs, gulab jamun and Biryani. The quantity for meal box was decent for 1 -2 person.  Paneer Makhani Biryani had all of the classic flavours and tasted just amazing.

Overall whole meal from Go! Biryan was superb and worth ordering! Their North Indian food was droolworthy and satisfying meal. Definately gonna check this place out again for ordering online.

featured_reviews.name: SK AYUB
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re craving a hearty, juicy seekh kabab with all the right spices and smoky flavor, Laziz Seekh Kabab Corner is a must-visit spot! Hidden in plain sight, this local gem offers an unforgettable dining experience for those who love their food loaded with flavor and cooked to perfection.

Ambiance

The atmosphere at Laziz Seekh Kabab Corner is casual and unpretentious. The small, cozy setting creates a welcoming vibe, perfect for grabbing a quick meal or enjoying a laid-back dinner with friends. It's not overly flashy, but the focus here is all about the food, and they deliver in that department!

Food & Quality

When it comes to the kababs themselves, the star of the show is undeniably the seekh kebabs. The meat is always fresh, tender, and bursting with a perfectly balanced blend of spices. Each bite delivers a satisfying combination of savory flavors, with just the right amount of heat to keep things interesting. The kababs are expertly grilled, leaving them with a mouthwatering smokiness that's hard to beat.

The menu also features other items like chicken tikka, reshmi kebabs, and naan, which pair beautifully with the seekh kebabs. The naan is soft and fluffy, and the dips (like mint chutney and raita) complement the kababs wonderfully, adding a fresh and tangy contrast.

Service

The service is quick and efficient, and the staff is friendly, often going out of their way to make sure your experience is a great one. Whether you're a regular or a first-timer, you're treated like an old friend. Expect the food to arrive hot and fresh, making every bite worth the wait.

Price

Laziz Seekh Kabab Corner offers great value for money. The prices are very reasonable, especially considering the quality of food you’re getting. You won’t feel like you're breaking the bank, but you'll definitely leave feeling satisfied.
